title: Pan-fried sole with lemon lentils and spring vegetables
blurb: Tender sole fillets served over coral lentils cooked with carrots and peas, finished with a bright shallot and lemon sauce.
steps: Peel and dice the carrots into small cubes, then finely chop the shallots and zest half the lemon.
Rinse the lentils under cold water, then put them in a pan with the vegetable stock and bring to a simmer.
Add the carrots to the lentils and cook for 12 minutes until both are tender, then stir in the peas and cook for 3 more minutes.
While the lentils cook, heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and season the sole fillets with salt and pepper.
Fry the sole for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through, then remove to a warm plate.
Add the butter and shallots to the same pan and cook for 2 minutes until softened, then squeeze in the lemon juice and add the zest.
Divide the lentils and vegetables between two plates, place the sole on top and spoon over the shallot and lemon sauce.
